rubric: The message is complete and ready to send; nothing is a fragment or a placeholder beyond names the user did not give.
The main sentence (the ask, the news, the apology) comes first; the next step and a date close it.
Tone matches the reader (formal for boss, landlord, authority; warm for friends); a subject line for emails only.
No invented facts, promises or deadlines; every fact the user gave is kept exactly.
Answer is in the user's language with a fitting greeting and sign-off; at most one short follow-up line.
